swim.stroke.backstroke.name: 仰泳
swim.stroke.backstroke.summary: 仰卧交替划臂配合打腿；头髋线稳定。
swim.stroke.breaststroke.name: 蛙泳
swim.stroke.breaststroke.summary: 双手同时划水与鞭状腿并滑行；比赛中有合法波浪幅度限制。
swim.stroke.butterfly.name: 蝶泳
swim.stroke.butterfly.summary: 双臂同时移臂配合海豚腿；划水与踢腿节奏关键。
swim.stroke.freestyle.name: 自由泳（爬泳）
swim.stroke.freestyle.summary: 连续交替划臂配合打腿；脸入水并配合节奏呼吸。
swim.stroke.individual_medley.name: 个人混合泳
swim.stroke.individual_medley.summary: 个人混合泳顺序：蝶泳、仰泳、蛙泳、自由泳。
